game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay, a hidden smugglers' bay: the dock cartographer must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Gatekeeper If: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors.
theme: Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay: a hidden smugglers' bay
core_gameplay_loop: In Smugglers' Bay, repeat each round: Write a single if condition that opens the gate only for friendly visitors. Each round, jellyfish swarms strike the cargo hold, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gate_integrity value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cargo hold from jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay: keep the gate_integrity meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: gate_integrity drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Gatekeeper If
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Gatekeeper If' (Week 3 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Smugglers' Bay'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gate_integrity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while gate_integrity > 0.
